# f5xc_securemesh_site (Resource)

Secure Mesh site defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage an Secure Mesh site.

To get more information about f5xc_securemesh_site, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-securemesh-site)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Securemesh Site - Basic

resource "f5xc_securemesh_site" "example" {
  name      = "example-sms"
  namespace = "system"

  volterra_certified_hw = "isv-8000-series-voltmesh"

  master_node_configuration = [
    {
      name = "master-node-1"
    }
  ]

  bond_choice = {
    no_bond_devices = true
  }

  network_cfg_choice = {
    default_network_config = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  blocked_services_choice = {
    default_blocked_services = true
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Securemesh Site - Full

resource "f5xc_securemesh_site" "example" {
  name      = "example-sms"
  namespace = "system"

  labels = {
    env   = "dev"
    owner = "platform"
  }

  annotations = {
    purpose = "acceptance"
  }

  address = "123 Main Street, Seattle, US"

  volterra_certified_hw = "isv-8000-series-voltmesh"

  waf_signatures = {
    signatures_update_mode_choice = {
      manual = true
    }
  }

  master_node_configuration = [
    {
      name      = "master-node-1"
      public_ip = "192.0.2.10"
    },
    {
      name      = "master-node-2"
      public_ip = "192.0.2.11"
    },
    {
      name      = "master-node-3"
      public_ip = "192.0.2.12"
    }
  ]

  worker_nodes = ["worker-node-1"]

  bond_choice = {
    no_bond_devices = true
  }

  network_cfg_choice = {
    default_network_config = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  blocked_services_choice = {
    default_blocked_services = true
  }

  offline_survivability_mode = {
    offline_survivability_mode_choice = {
      enable_offline_survivability_mode = true
    }
  }

  performance_enhancement_mode = {
    perf_mode_choice = {
      perf_mode_l3_enhanced = {
        perf_mode_choice = {
          jumbo = true
        }
      }
    }
  }

  kubernetes_upgrade_drain = {
    kubernetes_upgrade_drain_enable_choice = {
      disable_upgrade_drain = true
    }
  }

  timeouts = {
    create = "30m"
    read   = "5m"
    update = "30m"
    delete = "30m"
  }
}
```

- `interface_list` (Attributes) List of Interfaces Add all interfaces belonging to this site<br>Conflicts with `default_interface_config`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list))

<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list`

Required:

- `interfaces` (Attributes List) List of Interfaces Configure network interfaces for this Secure Mesh site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list.interfaces`

Required:

- `interface_choice` (Attributes) Interface Config Type Select the interface configuration type<br>Exactly one of `dedicated_interface`, `dedicated_management_interface`, or `ethernet_interface` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice))

Optional:

- `dc_cluster_group_connectivity_interface_choice` (Attributes) DC Cluster Group Connectivity Controls whether this interface will be used to connect to other sites in DC Cluster Group. If no interfaces are enabled, the default gateway interface will be used.<br>Exactly one of `dc_cluster_group_connectivity_interface_disabled` or `dc_cluster_group_connectivity_interface_enabled` must be specified when `dc_cluster_group_connectivity_interface_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--dc_cluster_group_connectivity_interface_choice))
- `description` (String) Interface Description Description for this Interface<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `labels` (Map of String) Interface labels Add Labels for this Interface, these labels can be used in firewall policy

<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list.interfaces.interface_choice`

Optional:

- `dedicated_interface` (Attributes) Bootstrap Local Interface Configuration can be used to set labels, MTU and priority for dedicated interfaces. Networking configuration for dedicated interface is configured locally on site e.g. (outside/inside)Ethernet<br>Conflicts with `dedicated_management_interface` and `ethernet_interface`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface))
- `dedicated_management_interface` (Attributes) Dedicated Management Interface Fallback management interfaces can be made into dedicated management interface<br>Conflicts with `dedicated_interface` and `ethernet_interface`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_management_interface))
- `ethernet_interface` (Attributes) Ethernet Interface Ethernet interface configuration.<br>Conflicts with `dedicated_interface` and `dedicated_management_interface`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface))

<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list.interfaces.interface_choice.dedicated_interface`

Required:

- `device` (String) Device Name of the device for which interface is configured. Use wwan0 for 4G/LTE.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthBetween(1, 64)`

Optional:

- `monitoring_choice` (Attributes) Select Link Quality Monitoring configuration Link Quality Monitoring configuration for a network interface. When enabled, VER will send probes on the network interface to monitor quality of the link. Links are assigned a score based on the result of probes.<br>Exactly one of `monitor` or `monitor_disabled` must be specified when `monitoring_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--monitoring_choice))
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum Packet Size (MTU) Maximum packet size (Maximum Transfer Unit) of the interface When configured, mtu must be between 512 and 9000
- `node_choice` (Attributes) Select Node Independent or Node Specific Interface Cluster configuration will apply to a given device on all nodes of the site. Node configuration will apply to a given device on a specific node.<br>Exactly one of `cluster` or `node` must be specified when `node_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--node_choice))
- `primary_choice` (Attributes) Primary Interface Select if this interface is primary interface, only one interface can be primary in a given fleet<br>Exactly one of `is_primary` or `not_primary` must be specified when `primary_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--primary_choice))
- `priority` (Number) Priority Priority of the network interface when multiple network interfaces are present in outside network Greater the value, higher the priority

<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--monitoring_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list.interfaces.interface_choice.dedicated_interface.monitoring_choice`

Optional:

- `monitor` (Boolean) Monitoring enabled Link Quality Monitoring parameters. Choosing the option will enable link quality monitoring.<br>Conflicts with `monitor_disabled`.
- `monitor_disabled` (Boolean) Monitoring disabled Link quality monitoring disabled on the interface.<br>Conflicts with `monitor`.


<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--node_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list.interfaces.interface_choice.dedicated_interface.node_choice`

Optional:

- `cluster` (Boolean) Cluster Configuration will apply to given device on all nodes of the site.<br>Conflicts with `node`.
- `node` (String) Node Configuration will apply to a device on the given node of the site.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthBetween(1, 64)`<br>Conflicts with `cluster`.


<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--primary_choice"></a>

Optional:

- `not_primary` (Boolean) Interface is Not Primary This interface is not primary<br>Conflicts with `is_primary`.

- `node_choice` (Attributes) Select Node Independent or Node Specific Interface Cluster configuration will apply to a given device on all nodes of the site. Optional:

- `cluster` (Boolean) Cluster Configuration will apply to given device on all nodes of the site.<br>Conflicts with `node`.
- `node` (String) Node Configuration will apply to a device on the given node of the site.<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthBetween(1, 64)`<br>Conflicts with `cluster`.

- `primary_choice` (Attributes) Primary Interface Select if this interface is primary interface, only one interface can be primary in a given fleet<br>Exactly one of `is_primary` or `not_primary` must be specified when `primary_choice` is configured. Optional:

- `fixed_ip_map` (Map of String) Fixed IP Assignments Assign fixed IPv4 addresses based on the MAC Address of the DHCP Client.
- `interfaces_addressing_choice` (Attributes) Interface IP(s) Specify how interfaces on each node are assigned local address<br>Exactly one of `automatic_from_end`, `automatic_from_start`, or `interface_ip_map` must be specified when `interfaces_addressing_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface--address_choice--dhcp_server--dhcp_networks--network_prefix_choice))

- `dns_choice` (Attributes) DNS Server Address Select how DNS server address is determined. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface--address_choice--dhcp_server--dhcp_networks--dns_choice))

(see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface--address_choice--dhcp_server--dhcp_networks--gateway_choice))
- `pools` (Attributes List) DHCP pools List of non overlapping ip address ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface--address_choice--dhcp_server--dhcp_networks--pools))

- `same_as_dgw` (Boolean) Default Gateway Address DNS server address is same as default gateway address<br>Conflicts with `dns_address`.


<a id="nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface--address_choice--dhcp_server--dhcp_networks--gateway_choice"></a>

- `dgw_address` (String) Configured Address Enter a IPv4 address from the network prefix to be used as the default gateway.<br>Conflicts with `first_address` and `last_address`.
- `first_address` (Boolean) First Address First usable address from the network prefix is chosen as default gateway<br>Conflicts with `dgw_address` and `last_address`.
- `last_address` (Boolean) Last Address Last usable address from the network prefix is chosen as default gateway<br>Conflicts with `dgw_address` and `first_address`.

Optional:

- `end_ip` (String) End IP Ending IP of the pool range. In case of address allocator, offset is derived based on network prefix. 10.1.1.200 with prefix length of 24, end offset is 0.0.0.200
- `start_ip` (String) Start IP Starting IP of the pool range. In case of address allocator, offset is derived based on network prefix. 10.1.1.5 with prefix length of 24, start offset is 0.0.0.5

<a id="nestedatt--offline_survivability_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offline_survivability_mode`

Optional:

- `offline_survivability_mode_choice` (Attributes) offline_survivability_mode_choice Offline Survivability allows the Site to continue functioning normally without traffic loss during periods of connectivity loss to the Regional Edge (RE) or the Global Controller (GC). When this feature is enabled, a site can continue to function as is with existing configuration for upto 7 days, even when the site is offline. The certificates needed to keep the services running on this site are signed using a local CA. Secrets would also be cached locally to handle the connectivity loss. When the mode is toggled, services will restart and traffic disruption will be seen.<br>Exactly one of `enable_offline_survivability_mode` or `no_offline_survivability_mode` must be specified when `offline_survivability_mode_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offline_survivability_mode--offline_survivability_mode_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--offline_survivability_mode--offline_survivability_mode_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offline_survivability_mode.offline_survivability_mode_choice`

Optional:

- `enable_offline_survivability_mode` (Boolean) Enable Offline Survivability Mode<br>Conflicts with `no_offline_survivability_mode`.
- `no_offline_survivability_mode` (Boolean) Disable Offline Survivability Mode<br>Conflicts with `enable_offline_survivability_mode`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_securemesh_site.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_securemesh_site.example
}
```
